commentary: The GPU rental waterfall shows clear tiering as of late October 2026: frontier B200 commands $8-9/hr typical on-demand (with aggressive spot at $3.75-4.78/hr), H200 mid-$5s, workhorse H100 clusters $4/hr, and bottom-tier A100 80GB converging toward $1.50-1.80/hr on managed clouds. Vast.ai marketplace floors remain 50-70% below on-demand for interruptible capacity. Nebius's October price hike (17-21% across Hopper/Blackwell) signals supply remains tight even as Blackwell ramps, supporting the view that utilization and contract backlog justify rate power for neo-clouds.
